ambient_events: Water drips somewhere close, each drop echoing longer than it should.
Far off, something heavy shifts in the dark and settles again.
A cold draft breathes up out of the tunnels, carrying rot and iron.
description: The bottom of the Ironside storm drain. A rusted service ladder climbs back up toward a coin of grey daylight overhead; below it, brick tunnels run off into total black in three directions. The floor is a shallow sheet of cold water skinned with grease. Whatever light you carry is the only light there is down here.

flags.intro_lore: This is where the city's runoff goes to be forgotten, and lately where its newest citizens go to bleed off their first real fear. The Under doesn't hate you — it simply doesn't account for you at all. Down here the only thing between you and the dark is two cells and a bulb. Keep it lit.

name: Storm Drain Sump
